# Copilot Instructions

- Keep the frontend responsive for mobile and desktop.
- Build the app around modular pages and reusable components.
- Keep API integration isolated in service files so backend contracts can be replaced later.
- Use realistic mock data during the frontend phase before the backend is connected.
- Maintain a clean, business-oriented dashboard design for workforce operations.
- Prioritize worker, company, attendance, payroll, advance, and document workflows.
- Prepare all pages so data can be connected to a real API once the backend is ready.
